# Risk register — PaketPort Group

Generated view of `isms/risk/risk-register.yaml`, scored against the criteria in `isms/risk/risk-criteria.yaml` (clauses 6.1.2, 6.1.3 and 8.2). The Statement of Applicability cites these risk ids as the justification for including controls.

## Criteria

Risks are identified per asset group as threat/vulnerability pairs and scored as likelihood times impact on two five-point scales (1-25). The inherent score assumes no controls beyond what is legally unavoidable; the residual score is re-assessed after the planned treatment. Scores fall into four bands that determine the response and who may retain residual risk. Risks are reviewed at least annually, after significant incidents and whenever the scope changes.

| Band | Scores | Response | May be retained by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| low | 1–4 | Monitor; treat opportunistically. May be retained by the ISMS manager and reviewed annually. | Information Security Officer / ISMS Manager |
| medium | 5–9 | Treat within twelve months, or retain by decision of the Managing Director with a documented rationale. | Managing Director |
| high | 10–15 | Treat within three months with an owner and a plan; retention only by the Managing Director and only while the plan runs. | Managing Director |
| critical | 16–25 | Treat immediately and escalate to the management review. Never retained. | never |
